title: Testing Conditional Stochastic Dominance via Copula Derivatives
abstract: arXiv:2609.21622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Comparing two populations at the same physical covariate value requires more than conditional means or isolated target-point decisions: researchers may need evidence about an entire conditional-distribution ordering over a continuum, even when covariate margins differ. This paper makes that common-value comparison estimable under an explicit structure--flexibility tradeoff and turns the resulting surface into simultaneous evidence for first-order stochastic dominance. Population-specific margins map the common covariate value into each group, while a fitted copula-derivative representation links conditional distributions across the region. Uniform inference propagates uncertainty from both the margins and dependence model through a one-sided statistic with unknown binding locations. translated_title: 通过Copula导数检验条件随机占优
translated_abstract: 在同一物理协变量取值处比较两个总体，所需的信息远不止条件均值或孤立的目标点决策：研究者可能需要关于一个连续区间上整个条件分布排序的证据，即使两组的协变量边缘分布不同。本文在明确的“结构-灵活性”权衡下使这种共同取值比较变得可估计，并将由此得到的曲面转化为一阶随机占优的同时性证据。各总体特有的边缘分布将共同的协变量取值映射到每个组内，而拟合的Copula导数表示则在整个区域内将条件分布联系起来。一致推断通过一个具有未知绑定位置的单边统计量，将来自边缘分布和依赖模型两方面的不确定性传播开来。在有限Copula类内的正确设定、光滑性与修剪条件，以及唯一最优候选族的假设下，该程序允许……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Copula导数的方法，通过总体特定的边缘分布映射共同协变量取值并辅以一致推断，在协变量边缘分布不同的情况下，对连续区间上两个总体的条件分布进行一阶随机占优的同时性检验。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a copula-derivative-based procedure that uses population-specific margins to map common covariate values and uniform one-sided inference to deliver simultaneous tests of first-order stochastic dominance between conditional distributions over a continuum, even when covariate margins differ.
